# Coursera

> > Coursera is a global online learning platform offering courses, professional certificates, and degrees from top universities (Stanford, University of Michigan, Johns Hopkins) and industry leaders (Google, IBM, Meta, Microsoft, DeepLearning.AI).

The platform provides flexible, accessible education across data science, AI, business, and technology, featuring subscription options like Coursera Plus for unlimited access. Coursera serves both individual learners and enterprises through Coursera for Business, with a growing focus on generative AI and career-oriented certificate programs.

## Key Topics

- Coursera Plus subscription model
- Professional Certificates from Google, IBM, Meta
- Online Degrees and Master's Programs
- Generative AI and DeepLearning.AI courses
- Python, Cloud Computing (AWS, Google Cloud)
- Career Development and Learning Paths
- Coursera for Business enterprise solutions
- University Partners (Stanford, University of Michigan, Johns Hopkins)
- Beginner-Friendly Learning
- Flexible Online Education
- Certificate Programs and Credentials
- AI in Higher Education
- Hands-on Guided Projects
- Course Catalog across Business, Tech, Data Science

## Platform Overview

- [Coursera | Courses, Professional Certificates, and Degrees Online](https://coursera.org): Homepage featuring courses from Google, IBM, Meta and university partners
- [About Coursera](https://coursera.org/about): Company mission and vision for accessible world-class learning
- [How does Coursera work? Get started on Coursera](https://coursera.org/about/how-coursera-works): Getting started guide explaining Coursera's learning paths and course types
- [Coursera Plus | Unlimited Access to 10,000+ Online Courses](https://coursera.org/courseraplus): Coursera Plus subscription product page with pricing and unlimited access
- [Coursera Account Portal](https://accounts.coursera.org): Main landing page promoting Coursera's online learning platform and courses

## Course Catalog

- [Best Online Courses & Certificates [2026]](https://coursera.org/courses): Course catalog with Google AI, Data Analytics, and professional certificates
- [Coursera Online Course Catalog by Topic and Skill](https://coursera.org/browse): Browse courses by category including data science, business, and tech
- [Guided Projects](https://coursera.org/campus/guided-projects): Hands-on tutorials for campus using Power BI, Docker, Jira, and Excel

## Learning Guides and Roadmaps

- [How to Learn Artificial Intelligence: A Beginner's Guide](https://coursera.org/articles/how-to-learn-artificial-intelligence): Beginner's guide to learning AI with Google AI and foundational courses
- [Docker Learning Roadmap: Beginner to Expert (2026)](https://coursera.org/resources/docker-learning-roadmap): Complete roadmap for learning Docker from basics to DevOps applications
- [C# Learning Roadmap: Skills, Courses, Topics (2026)](https://coursera.org/resources/c-sharp-learning-roadmap): C# learning path from basics to .NET frameworks and cloud development
- [10 Surprising Benefits of Online Learning in 2026](https://coursera.org/articles/benefits-of-online-learning): Article on flexibility, cost savings, and career benefits of online education
- [How to Create a Study Guide: Everything You Need to Know](https://coursera.org/articles/create-a-study-guide): Guide on creating effective study guides using active learning strategies

## Technical Reference

- [What Is Git? Use Cases and FAQ](https://coursera.org/articles/what-is-git): Introduction to Git version control system with commands and use cases
- [What Is Cloud Computing? 15 FAQs for Beginners](https://coursera.org/in/articles/what-is-cloud-computing): Beginner FAQ guide covering cloud computing basics and infrastructure
- [What Is an API? (+ How Do They Work?)](https://coursera.org/articles/what-is-an-api): Explanation of APIs, types (REST, SOAP), and programming examples
- [Excel Structured Reference Tutorial: Step-by-Step Guide](https://coursera.org/articles/excel-structured-reference): Tutorial on using structured references in Excel tables and formulas
- [How to Make a Graph in Google Sheets](https://coursera.org/articles/how-to-make-a-graph-in-google-sheets): Step-by-step guide to creating and customizing graphs in Google Sheets

## FAQs and Support

- [Cybersecurity Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)](https://coursera.org/articles/cybersecurity-faq): FAQ on cybersecurity careers, skills, certifications, and job outlook
- [Project Management Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)](https://coursera.org/articles/project-management-faq): FAQ on project management careers, salaries, and Google certifications
- [Master's Degrees Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ)](https://coursera.org/articles/masters-degree-faq): FAQ on master's degree requirements, duration, and career benefits

## News and Insights

- [AI in Higher Education 2026 Report](https://blog.coursera.org/ai-in-higher-education-2026): Report on AI adoption and educator preparedness in higher education

## Optional

- [Beginner English: About You](https://coursera.org/learn/beginner-english-about-you): A1-A2 CEFR beginner English course for self-introduction and basics
- [Automation Business Analysis - Concepts and Principles](https://coursera.org/learn/automation-business-analyst): UiPath course on RPA business analysis fundamentals and process mapping
- [Shortest Paths Revisited, NP-Complete Problems and What To Do About Them](https://coursera.org/learn/algorithms-npcomplete): Advanced algorithms course by Tim Roughgarden on NP-complete problems
- [Airport Infrastructure](https://coursera.org/learn/airport-infrastructure): Transportation systems course on airport design and terminal planning
- [Computer Hardware and Software](https://coursera.org/learn/computer-hardware-software): Beginner course on computer basics, hardware components, and networking
- [WordPress 101 - The Complete Guide](https://coursera.org/learn/packt-wordpress-101-the-complete-guide-lgzu2): Complete WordPress course covering themes, plugins, and SEO optimization
